answer: Price every attestation by what it costs to replicate: CPU seconds, disk, network. Expire any credit not renewed by fresh work within 3 epochs. What breaks first is the cheap corner: a willow of identities that only attest, never compute, costs near zero and expires fast. A forge of 500 such accounts needs 500 renewals per rotation to stay alive. The saffron of that fee is small; the 3-epoch deadline is not.
